noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

callback.description:
This attribute names the function defined in the annotated field’s type that
is to be executed when the current field is proposed to be changed. This
function will check the values of annotated field and emit a result of the
validation that can be used to mark the field value as valid or not. Any error
messages related to the validation result may also be emitted
function(T affectedObj) : {status:boolean, message :string}

expr.description:
This attribute defines an expression that identifies a valid set of options
that applies to the annotated field. The expression will be evaluated against
the object holding the annotated field and expected result is an array of
objects with type being the type of the annotated field

required.description:
A simple value for this annotation field can be true, which means
the field is required at all times.

title:
Annotation for field validation. Defines a callback function to validate changes,
an expression for valid options, and a requirement flag for mandatory fields.
name: Ann.Validation
